name: Sim
description: Workspace for building and running agents visually, by conversation or in code, with integrations and knowledge bases.
whatItDoes: Teams create agents and workflows connected to Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Salesforce, databases and many other services. It ingests files and table data and monitors runs, logs and schedules.
howItWorks: A setup command bootstraps a self-hosted deployment backed by Docker. A cloud service and a macOS desktop app that can point at a self-hosted instance are also offered.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: For the models used by agents
